title: Classic Chicken Ballotine
description: A classic French chicken ballotine featuring tender chicken thighs stuffed with a light chicken mousse, gently poached, finished with a golden sear, and served with a velouté or jus.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken
items: Salt and freshly ground black pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Mousse (Stuffing)
items: Finely diced mushrooms (optional: wild or button) – 50 g
Salt and white pepper – to taste

ingredients.title: For the Sauce (Velouté or Jus)
items: Heavy cream – 50 ml (optional, for velouté style)

ingredients.title: For Garnish (Optional)
items: Fine baby vegetables (baby carrots, haricots verts, asparagus tips)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken
steps: Lay the chicken thighs skin-side down on a cutting board.
Trim off any excess fat. Lightly flatten the meat to an even thickness.
Season with salt and pepper.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Chicken Mousse
steps: In a food processor, blend chicken breast, egg white, salt, and white pepper into a smooth paste.
Slowly add cold cream while blending until a light mousse forms.
Fold in sautéed mushrooms, shallots, and thyme.
Chill for 20 minutes.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Assemble the Ballotine
steps: Spread a thin layer of mousse on each flattened chicken thigh.
Roll tightly into a cylinder, skin-side out.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap or cling film, twisting the ends like a sausage.
Secure with kitchen twine if needed.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Poach the Ballotine
steps: Heat a pot of water to 85°C (185°F) — not boiling.
Submerge the wrapped ballotines and poach for 20–25 minutes until firm and cooked through.
Remove, cool slightly, then unwrap.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Sear for Finish
steps: Heat olive oil and butter in a pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the ballotines on all sides until the skin is golden and crisp.
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Prepare the Sauce
steps: Sauté shallots in a little butter until translucent.
Deglaze with white wine, reducing by half.
Add chicken stock and reduce until thickened.
Stir in cream for a velouté-style sauce or whisk in butter off the heat for a glossy jus.
Season to taste.

servingSuggestions.title: Plating Suggestion (Fine Dining Style)
items: Slice the ballotine into 3–4 medallions and fan them neatly on the plate.
Spoon the sauce artfully around the chicken.
Arrange baby vegetables and a quenelle of mashed potato alongside.
Garnish with microgreens or chervil sprigs.

chefTips: Keep all mousse ingredients cold to prevent splitting.
You can sous-vide the ballotines at 75°C for 1 hour for perfect texture.
Add truffle oil or diced foie gras to the mousse for luxury.
Always rest the meat before slicing for clean presentation.
